synthesis.description: Each month a coordinator (Shari Mao, James Scribner, Suzanne Nicholie) sends the Hours Survey or activity driver survey with instructions, asking managers to record hours and activities for the month, often in a database or attached spreadsheet, by a stated deadline such as end of day Wednesday, April 5th. Reminders follow on the due date. Separately, team members report absences and vacation to whoever keeps their time, and staff are asked which commercial team they supported and in what share.
steps: The coordinator sends the monthly hours or activity survey with instructions and a due date.
Managers collect hours and activities from their team, sometimes using a provided spreadsheet.
Staff report absences, vacation and travel to the time keeper.
Survey responses or the completed file are entered or returned.
The coordinator chases late responses on and after the deadline.
Figures such as ATEs are checked and corrections returned before the data feeds the cost model.
synthesis.approach: Replace the emailed survey attachments with one standing time and activity form per month, pre-filled with each person's team and prior month's split, with automatic reminders before the deadline and a completion report for the coordinator. Absence and vacation notes go into the same form instead of free-text emails.
synthesis.rationale: Each round restates the same instructions and collects the same fields; a fixed template with prefilled data reduces entry and chasing, while managers still confirm their team's allocation.

formula.counted: 27 occ over 745 d = 24.48 mo; email: 10 short x2 + 13 medium x6 + 6 long x15 + 2 fwd x2 + 4 chaser x3 + 104 read x1 = 308.00 min = 12.58 min/mo; automatable 60/40/30/80/100/50% = 137.40 min = 5.61 min/mo
formula.estimated: 27.00 occ x 40 min/occ (estimate, mid of 15-120, basis inferred, 7 quotes from 7 occurrences) = 1,080.00 min = 44.12 min/mo; automatable 50% (estimate) = 22.06 min/mo; at the low end 15 min/occ = $19.67/mo, at the high end 120 min/occ = $101.71/mo (the row's automatable total)
formula.total: today 56.70 min/mo = 0.95 h/mo = $80.32/mo (email 12.58 min/mo = $17.82 + work 44.12 min/mo = $62.50); automatable 27.67 min/mo = 0.46 h/mo = $39.20/mo (counted email 5.61 min/mo = $7.95 + estimated work 22.06 min/mo = $31.25)
